referenceDna.annotatedDescription: The reference is a specialty coffee roastery site. The opening features a single highlighted coffee with a large lifestyle or product photograph and a serif display heading, paired with a short promise and a primary shop action. A roastery-story band introduces the business through a small labeled grid of values such as sourcing, roasting, specialty coffee, brewing, and goods. A subscription band promotes recurring delivery. A locations band lists cafe addresses. A testimonial band quotes customers. A community or newsletter close captures email. Warm off-white surfaces, deep espresso ink, and a high-contrast serif display against a clean sans body define the look.

rules: keep the first action visible and touch-safe
avoid horizontal overflow and collapsed hierarchy

requiredSignatureElements.description: Translate the single-feature editorial hero with client-cleared content.
Translate the labeled value grid with new-client content.
Translate the recurring-delivery band with a single clear action.

prohibitedPatterns: reuse Ember Roast brand, words, logo, photographs, testimonials or trade dress
invent awards, prices, locations, staff or outcomes
copy a source section or source code
generic repeated cards that erase the editorial rhythm
low contrast or inaccessible mobile actions
acceptanceChecks: Opening features a single clear hero with a visible primary action.
Roastery story reads as a labeled value grid, not a generic card wall.
Subscription and location bands each keep one decisive action.
At 390 px all sections and controls fit without horizontal overflow.
No source brand, photograph, review, or unsupported claim is reused.

review.notes: Official business page rendered HTTP 200 at both viewports. Recaptured with the supported scroll-settled full-page capture; desktop and mobile images verified to show all sections. Owned source; retained as internal design-mechanics reference only.
